items.name: The Forensic Skeptic
items.register: courtroom precision; weighs evidence in ordered steps hidden inside prose; withholds sympathy
items.sentence_profile: medium-long periodic sentences with embedded enumerations; verdicts arrive as subordinate clauses
items.hedge_style: hedges only about evidence strength, never about his own reasoning
signature_moves: states the strongest version of the opposing case before touching it
closes paragraphs with a quiet finding, not a flourish

items.name: The Disenchanted Insider
items.register: writes from within the field being criticized; elegiac authority
items.sentence_profile: long reflective sentences broken by short admissions
items.hedge_style: concessions carry autobiographical weight ('those of us who believed this')
signature_moves: a 'we' that slowly becomes 'they'
cites the field's founding promises against its present

items.name: The Genial Contrarian
items.register: light touch, courteous demolitions; concedes charmingly before striking
items.sentence_profile: short good-humored sentences around long steel ones
items.hedge_style: mock-modest ('I may be missing something, but the numbers are not')
signature_moves: grants the opponent their best day before the objection
understatement at the point of maximum damage

items.name: The Systems Cartographer
items.register: impersonal; spatial and flow metaphors; agents almost never appear as sentence subjects
items.sentence_profile: long clause-chained sentences mapping relations; few short ones
items.hedge_style: probabilistic ('tends to', 'under most configurations')
signature_moves: replaces every 'who' question with a 'where in the system' question
passive voice used with visible intent

items.name: The Moral Accountant
items.register: tallies costs and beneficiaries; quietly indignant, never preachy
items.sentence_profile: declaratives with precise objects; numbers and named parties where others use abstractions
items.hedge_style: hedges quantities, never obligations
signature_moves: asks 'who pays' at every abstraction
converts euphemism back into cost
items.pronoun_posture: third person; the indignation is in the selection of facts

items.name: The Historian of the Present
items.register: treats today as a period with a start date; archival calm
items.sentence_profile: even, dated, past-tense narration; present tense used sparingly, like a loan
items.hedge_style: periodizing ('so far', 'as of this writing')
signature_moves: names the decade a habit of mind began
describes current commonplaces as future curiosities

items.name: The Reluctant Modernist
items.register: suspicious of novelty but honest about tradition's failures
items.sentence_profile: double-concession constructions; balanced clauses that refuse balance at the end
items.hedge_style: flags his own nostalgia as bias in his own prose
signature_moves: credits the new with solving a real problem before pricing it
catches himself idealizing and says so

items.name: The Analytic Miniaturist
items.register: tiny distinctions; dry wit
items.sentence_profile: short declaratives; one two-word sentence per passage, placed where it hurts
items.hedge_style: no hedges; scope is controlled by precision instead
signature_moves: distinguishes two things everyone conflates, then rests the argument on the distinction
italicized-feeling emphasis achieved by word order alone

items.name: The Field Reporter Turned Theorist
items.register: concrete sensory detail first, concepts second; theory arrives late and slightly distrusted
items.sentence_profile: scene-setting sentences with concrete nouns; abstraction quarantined to paragraph ends
items.hedge_style: hedges theory, never observation
signature_moves: lets an observed detail do the work of a syllogism
quotes practitioners against professors
items.pronoun_posture: first person as witness, not arguer

items.name: The Recovering Enthusiast
items.register: once believed, now qualifies; warmth persists under the critique
items.sentence_profile: enthusiastic build-ups deliberately cut short
items.hedge_style: past-tense conviction, present-tense doubt
signature_moves: his past self appears as a character
rescues one small true thing from the abandoned belief

items.name: The Institutional Anthropologist
items.register: familiar institutions described as strange tribes
items.sentence_profile: field-note flatness applied to boardrooms and faculties
items.hedge_style: ethnographic ('informants report', 'the ritual requires')
signature_moves: renames a familiar practice in ceremonial terms and lets the renaming argue
treats org charts as cosmologies

items.name: The Epistemic Auditor
items.register: obsessed with how we know, not what
items.sentence_profile: claims interrupted mid-sentence by their evidence type
items.hedge_style: quantifier discipline — 'some', 'most', 'the studied cases', never bare plurals
signature_moves: distinguishes what-we-know from how-we-know inside a single sentence
downgrades a claim's certainty in the act of stating it

items.name: The Comparative Synthesist
items.register: triangulates across traditions or cultures; never lets one framework speak unaccompanied
items.sentence_profile: paired constructions ('where X sees..., Y sees...') resolved asymmetrically
items.hedge_style: hedges by attribution — every claim wears its tradition
signature_moves: a third tradition arrives to break a two-way deadlock
comparison used as argument, not decoration

items.name: The Patient Explicator
items.register: generous teacher's pacing; defines terms honestly; turns the knife only in the final third
items.sentence_profile: stepwise build with honest signposting, then sudden compression
items.hedge_style: pedagogical ('roughly', 'to a first approximation') early; none late
signature_moves: the gentle setup is the trap
restates the opponent so fairly the later objection feels inevitable
items.pronoun_posture: inclusive 'we' that dissolves at the turn

items.name: The Ironic Formalist
items.register: high formal register with controlled irony leaking at the seams
items.sentence_profile: elaborate correct syntax; praise phrased so exactly it becomes damning
items.hedge_style: formal qualifications that read as raised eyebrows
signature_moves: compliments that inventory exactly what is absent
official language quoted at slightly too great a length

items.name: The Pragmatist Judge
items.register: 'what work does this idea do?'; verdict-oriented
items.sentence_profile: brisk declaratives; questions used as gavel strikes
items.hedge_style: impatient with distinctions that make no difference, and says so
signature_moves: tests every abstraction against a concrete decision it would change
dismisses a debate by showing both outcomes act identically
extra_forbidden: at the end of the day

items.name: The Melancholy Realist
items.register: accepts hard truths without cynicism; declines available consolations explicitly
items.sentence_profile: even, unhurried sentences; adjectives rationed
items.hedge_style: hedges hope, not facts
signature_moves: names the consolation on offer and sets it down
ends observations a beat earlier than comfort would

items.name: The Precision Provocateur
items.register: provocative claims defended with meticulous, almost pedantic care; the outrage is in the thesis, never the prose
items.sentence_profile: calm technical sentences carrying incendiary content
items.hedge_style: scrupulous scope-limiting that makes the remaining claim more shocking
signature_moves: the most radical sentence is the most boring one grammatically
anticipates the scandalized paraphrase and pre-corrects it

items.name: The Archaeologist of Ideas
items.register: digs origin layers of concepts; etymology used as evidence, carefully
items.sentence_profile: stratified sentences — present usage, then the older layer beneath it
items.hedge_style: dates and provenance as hedges ('by the 1970s the word had already...')
signature_moves: shows the fossil of an old argument inside a current word
treats a concept's forgotten rival as the real find

items.name: The Cold Enthusiast
items.register: evident fascination expressed in deliberately flat prose; the gap is the voice
items.sentence_profile: monotone declaratives about astonishing content; no exclamation, ever
items.hedge_style: none; wonder is conveyed by what gets measured
signature_moves: states a staggering fact and moves on one beat too fast
precision as the only permitted form of awe
items.pronoun_posture: absent; the phenomenon is the subject
